## MOCK ONLY — do not activate

Inactive, manual-trigger walkthrough.

- No Gmail / SMTP / webhook / schedule
- Notion HTTP is **disabled and unconnected**
- `sent` is always `false`
- On-demand OFF (do not publish or enable)

Import → keep inactive → Test workflow.
Pin data = Brightline billing sample.

## Flow

1. **Mock Ingest** — fictional email JSON
2. **Classify & Summarize** — deterministic stub (no LLM)
3. **Build Notion Upsert JSON** — Inbox + Task + Retries payloads
4. **Human Approval Send Gate** — never sends
5. **Retries Log** — empty-body / send-gate rows

Notion HTTP sits unused on the right.

nodes.name: Mock Ingest
nodes.notes: Manual only. No webhook, no schedule, on-demand OFF.

nodes.name: Classify & Summarize (stub)
nodes.notes: Deterministic keyword stub. Same rules as src/feedback-ops.mjs. No LLM.

nodes.name: Build Notion Upsert JSON
nodes.notes: Builds Notion API JSON only. Does not call Notion.

nodes.name: Approved — Hold Send (sent=false)
nodes.notes: Even approved drafts never send in this mock.

nodes.name: Retries Log
nodes.notes: Writes retry/exception JSON only. No outbound calls.

nodes.name: Notion HTTP (disabled / unconnected)
nodes.notes: Intentionally disabled and unconnected. No credentials. Mock never writes to Notion.
